title: Find the Impostor
description: Find the Impostor! PvE minigame with Smart AI, Random Events & 1.16-1.21 Support.
body:
#

FindGame

###

*The Ultimate PvE Deduction Minigame*

Click here to try the first Version

Test your observation skills. Find the impostor. Survive the chaos.

---


Can you spot the nervous villager before time runs out?

## What is FindGame? FindGame is a highly optimized, single-player PvE minigame designed for servers of all types (Lobby, Survival, RPG). The concept is simple but addictive: You are placed in an arena filled with villagers. One of them is an **Impostor**. Your goal? Observe their behavior, find the odd one out, and eliminate them before the timer ends. But be careful—if you hit an innocent, you lose a life. ## Key Features > [!TIP] > **Smart AI Personalities:** Villagers aren't just static entities. They act differently based on their generated personality. * **Universal Support (1.16 - 1.21):** Built to work flawlessly on modern versions, using native packets for titles, bossbars, and particles. * **Random Events:** Random events like **Blackouts** (Blindness) or **Mass Panic** (Speed) will test your reflexes. * **Full Customization:** Every message, title, and sound is configurable. Supports HEX Colors (`{#FFFFFF}`). * **Visual Polish:** Includes Villager Biome Skins (Desert, Snow, Jungle) to match your arena aesthetics. * **Easy Setup:** No complex coordinates. Use the in-game **Setup Wand** to create arenas in seconds. * **Zero Dependencies:** Plug and play. No extra libraries required. ---


Setting up an arena takes less than a minute.

## The AI System The core of this plugin is the behavior system. The impostor isn't random; they act suspicious. * **The Nervous One:** Jumps frequently and sweats (particles) when you look at them. * **The Killer:** Tries to blend in but will kill innocent villagers if you aren't looking. * **The Shy One:** Will actively run away from you if you get too close. ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `/findgame start [arena]` | Join a specific arena or a random one. | | `/findgame leave` | Quit the current match. | | `/findgame stats` | Check your winrate and games played. | | `/findgame top` | View the top 10 detectives. | **Admin Commands** (Permission: `findgame.admin`) * `/findgame create ` - Create a new arena. * `/findgame wand ` - Get the wand to set NPC spawns. * `/findgame reload` - Reload configuration instantly. ## Placeholders (PAPI) Display player statistics using **PlaceholderAPI**: ```yaml %findgame_wins% # Total wins. %findgame_played% # Games played. %findgame_winrate% # Efficiency percentage. %findgame_max_level% # Highest level reached. ``` ## Configuration Everything is translatable. We support modern HEX colors. ```yaml messages: game-start: "{#00FFFF}The search begins! {#E0E0E0}Level: {#FFD700}{level}" bossbar-text: "{#FFFF00}Time Remaining: {#FFFFFF}{time}s" impostor-hint: "{#B0B0B0}Clue: The suspect seems to be... {#00FFFF}{type}" ```

Ready to challenge your players?

Download FindGame Premium now!
